### The Music of Christmas
Author: Mike Pohlman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-dec-18-2008-11597120.html
Passage: Luke 1:68
Points:
- Zechariah’s prophetic hymn offers rich theology that points believers to the true heart of the season.
- Having been silenced for doubting God's promise, Zechariah used his restored speech to bless and praise the Lord.
- The song celebrates God's covenant faithfulness in raising up the long-promised Redeemer from David's line.
- Salvation originates solely in the tender mercy of God, bringing complete forgiveness of sins.
- Deliverance from spiritual enemies empowers believers to serve God without fear in righteousness all their days.
